name: Cuenca
tagline: Blue-domed colonial city of rivers and Panama hats
summary: Cuenca is Ecuador's loveliest colonial city, with sky-blue cathedral domes, flower markets and four rivers. Climb the New Cathedral's rooftop, see the Inca ruins at Pumapungo, learn how Panama hats are really made here, hike the lakes of Cajas National Park and visit the Inca temple of Ingapirca.
seasonNote: June to September is the drier season; it's spring-like all year at 2,500 m.
arrival: Mariscal Lamar airport is 10 minutes from the centre; buses from Guayaquil take 4 hours.
gettingAround: Walk the centre; tram and taxis.
cashTip: Ecuador uses the US dollar. Carry small bills; $20s can be hard to break and cards work mainly in bigger places.
buyTip: Toquilla straw hats, ceramics and silver.
